message: Recursive forced delete can irreversibly remove large directory trees.
safer_alternative: Use rm -ri <dir> for confirmation or test with ls first.

message: sudo with rm removes files as root and bypasses normal protection.
safer_alternative: Double-check path with pwd and ls. Consider moving files first.

message: Recursive 777 grants write/execute to everyone and can expose sensitive files.
safer_alternative: Use least-privilege permissions like 755/644 per use case.
Use >> to append, or back up files first.

message: mkfs formats storage devices and destroys existing data.
safer_alternative: Verify target device with lsblk before running.

message: dd can overwrite entire devices if input/output paths are wrong.
safer_alternative: Run a dry check with lsblk and echo paths before execution.

message: SIGKILL prevents graceful shutdown and can corrupt state.
safer_alternative: Try kill -15 first and target a specific PID.
